corsOrigins.name: corsOrigins
corsOrigins.description: Comma-separated list of origins allowed to call this API from a browser, e.g. "https://app.example.com". Also the allowlist the analytics ingest enforces server-side. Unset falls back to FRONTEND_URL plus localhost.

frontendUrl.name: frontendUrl
frontendUrl.description: This app's own web origin. Used as the single-entry CORS allowlist when CORS_ORIGINS is not set.

oauthProxyUrl.name: oauthProxyUrl
oauthProxyUrl.description: Origin of the host OAuth proxy this stage signs in through.

oauthProxyProviders.name: oauthProxyProviders
oauthProxyProviders.description: Comma-separated providers that sign in through the proxy, for example google,github.

oauthProxyKeyId.name: oauthProxyKeyId
oauthProxyKeyId.description: Identifier the proxy uses to find this stage key. Sent in the OAuth state.

sessionCookieCacheMaxAge.name: sessionCookieCacheMaxAge
sessionCookieCacheMaxAge.description: How long the signed session cookie is trusted before the API re-reads the session from the database. Also the longest a ban or a revoked session can go unnoticed. Defaults to 86400 (one day).

databaseUrl.name: databaseUrl
databaseUrl.description: Primary database connection string (Postgres or libsql URL)

lowStockThreshold.name: lowStockThreshold
lowStockThreshold.description: Item stock level that triggers a low-stock alert

scenarioActorSecret.name: scenarioActorSecret
scenarioActorSecret.description: Impersonation secret for `pikku scenario run` actors. Leave unset to disable actor sign-in

betterAuthUrl.name: betterAuthUrl
betterAuthUrl.description: Public origin the API is served from, used for auth callbacks and redirects
